s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Headrest Assembly (RH Seat Position)
Remove Rear Seat Headrest Assembly Center (RH Seat Position)
Remove Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.1 (RH Seat Position)

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.2 (RH Seat Position)

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.2.
Remove the 2 front side bolts of the rear seat assembly RH.
Fold the rear seat assembly RH forward.
Remove the 2 rear side bolts and remove the rear seat assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Seat Outer Belt Assembly Center (Seat Position RH Side)

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and disconnect the rear seat outer belt assembly center together with the rear seat inner belt assembly.
Remove the washer and rear seat outer belt assembly center from the rear seat inner belt assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 8 claws and remove the rear door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear door opening trim weatherstrip RH.
Remove the bolt and the rear seatback hinge.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Side Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear seat outer belt assembly RH from the guide and remove the rear seat side garnish RH.
Make sure that the ignition switch is OFF.
Check that the battery negative terminal is disconnected.

item.ptxt: If work is performed without disconnecting the battery negative terminal, the airbag may deploy even if an impact is applied only to the airbag sensor rear RH by itself, so always confirm that the battery negative terminal is disconnected before performing work.
After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from the airbag sensor rear RH.
Remove the nut and the airbag sensor rear RH.

item.ptxt: Be careful not to damage the pin on the back of the airbag sensor rear RH.
Be careful not to drop it or subject it to strong impacts.

s2.ptxt: Vehicles not involved in a collision, or vehicles involved in a collision in which the airbag did not deploy

s3.ptxt: If the C pillar or surrounding area has been damaged and the airbag has not deployed, replace the airbag sensor rear with a new one if any of the following applies.

specitem.ptxt: Deformation or peeling paint on the bracket or sensor body
Scratches, cracks or damage on the airbag sensor rear and connector
Damaged serial number or peeling label
